facts.fact: Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni told the Chamber of Representatives on 20 April 2026 that phase one of the national high and very high speed broadband plan (PNHD) is complete, with more than 10,690 of 10,740 zones covered by 2G, 3G and 4G, and phase two is launched for 2,000 new rural zones in 2026.

facts.fact: Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni said on 20 April 2026 that VSAT satellite technology is used in zones hard to serve by terrestrial networks, with each customer eligible for MAD 2,500 support per subscription, up to 4,000 beneficiaries a year.
